zh: 新增侧边栏交互式终端面板，集成 xterm.js 与 PTY 进程管理，支持实时执行与终端会话交互。
Agent 执行命令支持向右侧终端面板实时流式推送输出，命令执行过程一目了然。
优化推理模型调用参数兼容性，并完善 AI 101 课程及考勤验收工具交互。
en: Added an interactive Terminal Sidebar powered by xterm.js and PTY session management for live terminal access.
Agent tool commands now stream real-time execution output directly to the workspace terminal panel.
Improved reasoning model compatibility and updated AI 101 lessons and Attendance Acceptance tool.
